label: 2D Nhật hiện đại
static_style:
Modern Japanese 2D anime feature-film aesthetic; precise hand-drawn contours, controlled line-weight variation, expressive anime facial construction and clearly designed hair shapes. Preserve each character’s specified age, identity, facial proportions and silhouette. Use clean colour fills with two or three deliberate cel-shading tones and selective graphic highlights. Suggest materials through folds, linework, colour and shadow shapes rather than photographic microtexture. Maintain a consistently drawn 2D appearance across characters, props and effects. Avoid photoreal skin, sculpted CGI faces, glossy 3D shading and unrequested chibi transformations.

Environments should use richly painted anime backgrounds with coherent perspective, selective texture and atmospheric depth. Match background detail and colour design to the characters so both belong to the same scene. Follow the project’s established period, architecture, costumes and props. When present, magical effects should use designed 2D shapes, controlled glow and readable silhouettes without overwhelming the acting.

For narrative scenes, translate motivated light sources into clear cel-shadow shapes, deliberate colour relationships and restrained compositing. Keep eyes, expressions and silhouettes legible. Establish depth primarily through staging, overlap, scale and atmospheric perspective; use selective background softness sparingly. For white-background asset references, use clean model-sheet presentation, neutral colours, minimal cel shading and consistent proportions across views.
video_motion: For video, use a slightly choppy, intentionally stepped anime cadence on a 24 fps timeline: character animation mainly on twos, occasional holds on threes, and selective animation on ones for fast actions or expressive accents. Combine strong key poses, economical in-betweens and purposeful holds with subtle secondary motion. Camera moves may remain smooth independently of held character drawings. Keep linework, facial construction and colour fills stable. Avoid random stuttering, interpolated facial warping and uniformly ultra-smooth motion.
